title: Employee Home — Operational Variant
codex_guardrail: Variant of Employee Home. Keep useful personal actions, shift/attendance and attention items, but remove organization/team information that exceeds the employee's authorized scope. Do not introduce invented productivity/performance measures.
authority_note: Stitch is a visual/reference source. ErgonX backend/domain invariants, tenant isolation, RBAC, module gating, audit and lifecycle rules are authoritative.
